### Quality-Control Samples Removed

In this case, we remove any quality-control samples, such as pooled, blanks, or otherwise indicated as QC samples.

```{r}
#| label: not-qc
not_qc_variances = create_variance_values(
  pca_data$not_qc$pca$variance,
  ind = max_ind,
  group = max_group
)
```

#### Heatmap

```{r}
#| label: not-qc-heatmap
#| fig-cap: ICI-Kt sample-sample correlation heatmap, with correlation values, QC samples removed.
use_graphs$iterative_plots$not_qc$heatmap
```

#### Median Correlations

```{r}
#| label: not-qc-median
#| fig-cap: Median ICI-Kt sample-sample correlations by sample factors, after removing QC samples.
use_graphs$iterative_plots$not_qc$median_ici
```

#### Group Scores

```{r}
#| label: tbl-not-qc-icikt-scores
#| tbl-cap: Count (n_differences) and fraction (differences_fraction) of samples where between factors median ICI-Kt was higher than the within factors median ICI-Kt. QC samples removed.
pca_data$not_qc$scores |>
  create_grouping_scores_table("median-ici")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-not-qc-rle-scores
#| tbl-cap: Count (n_differences) and fraction (differences_fraction) of runs of each factors from hierarchical clustering differing from the expected number based on the number of samples in each factor. Outlier samples removed.
pca_data$not_qc$scores |>
  create_grouping_scores_table("rle")
```
